issues.detail: The freeze combines standard IDEAL 10T equipment with one explicitly published model-year 2023 track and rear-tyre combination. It is not a dealer order, serial-number record, or proof that every exterior micro-option was sold together in every country.

The live GB table presents ten model columns positionally. The compact 2301 matrix provides an explicit IDEAL 10T column; only values consistent across the exact column and current GB/product sources are admitted.

The 10.63 m length and 3.49 m selected carrier width exclude the table/header. The 10.70 m PowerFlow attachment width is separately bound. Because the retained header and unloading tube extend the visible X axis, that visible X extent is not a manufacturer-published overall envelope and must not be bound as public-envelope-x.

Official sources describe function and some limits but do not publish a dimensioned general arrangement, CAD, pivot coordinates, cylinder anchors, track roller spacing, belt path, auger hinges, header linkage geometry, or SwingFlow vane mechanism coordinates.

Older Fendt material contains a different standard auger and straw-spreading matrix. The 2301 technical matrix controls this package: 8.4 m folding tube, ShortCut, chaff spreader, and ActiveSpread SwingFlow.
No permission to reproduce manufacturer livery, logos, wordmarks, decals, trade dress, imagery, or geometry is asserted; the public model must remain neutral and independently authored.
